question: In what ways do the epithets identify the deity with bearing and ruling the earth?
premises: The deity is called lord of earth-bearers and lord of the earth.
The deity is described as having the nature of an earth-bearer.
inference: The deity is identified as both the supporter and sovereign of the earth, embodying that earth-bearing nature.
plain_english: He is the bearer of the earth, the lord of the bearers of the earth, the lord of the earth, and one whose nature is that of an earth-bearer.
